contract: Quantile results: exact shape/dtype; rtol=atol=8*eps(float64), equal NaNs. Suite units: exact canonical results, except interp-equalize (absolute 8*eps(float64)) and loadtxt-csv (equal NaNs). Preserve input buffers.
job: Compute linear quantiles over resident arrays, plus six timed numeric, time, random and I/O units over real data. Two further batches (strings-text, held-out only, and genfromtxt-catalog) are correctness-only.
measurement_boundary: Trusted external dispatch-to-stopped-worker timing includes the complete call batch, all copying/selection/sorting/interpolation, output materialization and result-address metadata. Input transfers and host numerical checking are outside; old outputs are released during the next timed batch. Suite units use the same resident boundary: the complete call batch and materialized results are timed; loading, argument derivation, canonical ordering, serialization and comparison are not.
name: NumPy
operations: np.quantile(a, q, axis=axis, method="linear", keepdims=keepdims, overwrite_input=False)
timing: Shared shim resident stop protocol; local execution reports no timing.
title: Compute quantiles and related NumPy operations over real data
readme_notes: Seven equally weighted timed units per scope: the linear-quantile batch and six suite units. The strings-text (held-out only) and genfromtxt-catalog batches are correctness-only checks.
